summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire MarketAxess Holdings. Under terms, each MarketAxess share will be converted into $167.00 in cash. ICE's board unanimously approved the transaction. Financing will come from available cash and incremental debt, with a commitment letter from Bank of America; funding is not a condition to closing. MarketAxess will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder vote; risk-arb centers on deal completion and financing certainty.
